description: A mounted rider in a black and gold robe and white turban sits on a black horse in the foreground, with other riders in tall caps and mail-like armour carrying spears and black banners. Behind them stand tall tan mud-brick walls with wooden scaffolding and small workers, a spiral tower rises on the right, smoke drifts above, and a river runs in the middle distance. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
